name: H5 lets ts-architect record a proposal with an inline Mermaid diagram (arrows and newlines inside quotes)

tool_input.command:
ts-opt proposal add --origin architect --rule struct-03 --file src/wrapper.ts --line 3 --recommendation STRONG --deletion-test "delete it: the complexity vanishes" --seam-test "one adapter" --touch src/wrapper.ts --plan-step "inline lengthOf into its single caller" --mermaid "flowchart TD
  subgraph Before
    A[index] --> B[wrapper] --> C[internal]
  end
  subgraph After
    A2[index] --> C2[internal]
  end"
